subject.title: [UX/Bug] Model selection array order is strictly bound to checkbox ticking sequence, causing unintended primary/fallback assignment

question: Should this ClawHub issue be transferred or recreated in the OpenClaw runtime repository, or should maintainers identify a concrete ClawHub registry/CLI integration gap to handle here?
rationale: The issue appears valid and aligned with OpenClaw priorities, but current ClawHub main does not contain the affected picker, persistence, or sync code, so automation cannot safely choose the owning product surface.

options.title: Transfer to OpenClaw runtime
options.body: Move the report to the repository that owns `openclaw configure`, model role persistence, and Web UI synchronization, preserving the reproduction steps.

options.title: Keep as ClawHub integration follow-up
options.body: Keep this open here only if maintainers identify a ClawHub package, registry, or CLI integration responsibility that directly affects the reported role assignment.

options.title: Wait for reporter proof
options.body: Ask for a screenshot, recording, or log before routing, at the cost of leaving a concrete setup bug without an owner.

recommendation.title: Transfer to OpenClaw runtime
recommendation.body: Move the report to the repository that owns `openclaw configure`, model role persistence, and Web UI synchronization, preserving the reproduction steps.
